title: MAST-Data (MAD)
licence: CC BY 4.0 (licence tag on the dataset card)
attribution: Cemri, Pan, Yang et al., "Why Do Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail?", NeurIPS 2025, arXiv:2503.13657; data: huggingface.co/datasets/mcemri/MAST-Data (CC BY 4.0). Records are shown as parsed by our reader and cut to short excerpts.
labels_made_by: an LLM judge (the dataset card: "not by human labelling"): 14 failure modes per run, 0 / 1
step_clock: 60 s a step from 2000-01-01 (undated runs only)
unit: one run = one trace; every share is runs out of runs, with a Wilson 95% interval

parsing.note: left out: HTTP and usage lines (ChatDev), token counters (OpenManus), loop markers and a second copy of each reply (AppWorld), start-up lines (HyperAgent)

as_logged.note: no record has a time, so the replay, the signs and the rules cannot run
